desc:
Avataria is a Roblox Avatar Creator where you can browse the catalog, try on thousands of UGC items for free, create outfits, and save them to your Roblox avatar.

👗 Create, save, and publish community outfits
💖 Follow stylists and discover new looks
🎁 Build your wishlist and gift items to friends
💃 Dance in sync with up to 4 friends
📸 Pose, edit photos, and choose backgrounds
🔎 Search any Roblox player and try on their outfit
✅ Items purchased in Avataria are added to your Roblox inventory and can be used in other experiences.

All purchases made in game will be added to your Roblox inventory & can be used in all games

Please REPORT inappropriate outfits.

Created by UGC creators MOSS and Tomoyo. All rights reserved
